title: PokéSurvivor best Pokémon — community picks
status: community picks, not an official ranking; version-sensitive

picks.name: Mewtwo
picks.summary: The Pokémon players call the strongest most often. Posts on X say it is close to unkillable by minute 20 and that players had settled on it as the best pick within a day of launch, and one player asks whether anything beats it. A Chinese video’s title calls it super strong with Swords Dance and Harden, and a Spanish strategy video says no Pokémon tops it.
picks.caveat: Not everyone agrees: a community-made stat chart puts it only in its A tier (31st to 120th of 966), while a guide site’s stat ranking has it in S. Psychic moves were weakened on October 11, 2026; most of the praise came after that, but the next balance change could move it.

picks.name: Gengar
picks.summary: Three videos single it out: a Spanish creator ranks it second in a top-five list, another video’s title calls its Gengar build very strong, and a third has a “top 3” segment on Gengar.
picks.caveat: We only had the titles and chapter names of two of these videos, so their reasons aren’t covered here.

sources.title: KNekroGamer’s video with a Gengar top 3

picks.name: Lucario
picks.summary: An Italian creator uses Lucario for S-rank runs, with a build that binds its moves into two Bonds, and the community-made stat chart ranks it 9th of all 966 Pokémon, well above Mewtwo.
picks.caveat: One of the two mentions is that stat chart, and we only had the video’s title, description and chapters.

sources.title: Community-made stat chart of all 966 Pokémon, game build a9b21f0

picks.name: Tentacruel
picks.summary: One Spanish creator ranks Tentacruel first: its poison keeps damaging enemies over time, and Shell Bell turns that damage into healing.
picks.caveat: That’s a single source, and the community-made stat chart only puts it in B. Its case is poison and healing rather than raw stats: its atk is the lowest of these four picks.

sources.title: Community-made stat chart of all 966 Pokémon, game build a9b21f0

notes.heading: Arceus Is Underwhelming as a Partner
notes.name: Arceus
notes.summary: A player on X expected Arceus to be the strongest partner and found it far behind, and a Spanish strategy video notes that its moves are mostly physical tackles, despite the highest bst on this page.

notes.heading: Legendaries Aren’t Automatically Best
notes.summary: A player on X finds a 4-star (epic) Pokémon easier to play than legendaries, another was let down by Arceus, and a creator’s top five has no legendary at all. Mewtwo is the exception players name most.

notes.heading: Rayquaza Is Awkward to Use
notes.name: Rayquaza
notes.summary: One creator finds Rayquaza hard to use: its large hitbox and weak Flying and Dragon moves hold it back, even with 1.52 atk.
